item_name: Rothco Join or Die Deluxe Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Join or Die Deluxe Low Profile Cap features “Join or Die” embroidered artwork on the front panels. The Join, or Die insignia was created by Benjamin Franklin in 1754 during the French and Indian War.
description: Rothco’s Join or Die Deluxe Low Profile Cap features “Join or Die” embroidered artwork on the front panels. The Join, or Die insignia was created by Benjamin Franklin in 1754 during the French and Indian War. This hat is made from cotton twill material, making it lightweight and durable. There is a comfortable padded sweatband inside the low profile cap. Top ventilation holes are there to keep your head cool. The front panels of the low-profile cap are made with Buckram to maintain its stiff shape. In the back of the cap there is an adjustable hook and loop closure to allow a comfortable fit for all heads.
